newsitem.title: FRANCE: Havas to buy Canal+ shares-sources.
newsitem.headline: Havas to buy Canal+ shares-sources.

text.p: French media group Havas has given Societe Generale a mandate to buy a significant part of the share capital in Canal Plus at a price per share of up to 1,200 francs, sources said.
At Havas, a spokeswoman said the company was "not in the market". A Societe Generale spokesman said the information was subject to business confidentiality and he could not comment.
"The Societe Generale has obtained a mandate to buy Canal Plus shares for Havas up to a limit of 1,200 francs," per share, one source said.
Another source said "Societe Generale could buy up to 10 percent of Canal Plus for Havas."

After the planned merger with Nethold, the stakes of Havas and Generale des Eaux will dilute. Havas will have 17.3 percent instead of 23.65 percent while Generale des Eaux will hold 15.4 percent instead of 20.4.
The two companies have already made clear that they aimed to bring their stakes back to their initial levels, with Generale des Eaux preferring non-cash operations.
On Friday, Belgium's Groupe Bruxelles Lambert bought a 1.33 percent stake in Canal Plus from Paribas .
